subject: Trading
title: David Einhorn: The Forensic Short
description: A micro-lesson that makes David Einhorn: The Forensic Short usable.

hook.text: David Einhorn publicly questioned Lehman Brothers' accounting in 2008. Months later, Lehman collapsed.

buildup.text: Einhorn specializes in deep forensic analysis—reading financial statements to find companies hiding problems.

discovery.text: He shorted Allied Capital, Lehman, and Green Mountain Coffee by finding accounting irregularities others missed.

twist.text: Short sellers are hated—companies fight back with lawsuits and PR campaigns. Einhorn faced intense pressure.

climax.text: Einhorn proves that forensic analysis can uncover fraud and weakness before the market—but requires courage under fire.

punchline.text: Reading footnotes closely is a legitimate superpower.

quiz.question: How did Einhorn identify his short-selling targets?
options: Deep forensic analysis of financial statements to find hidden problems
